audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Exodus / Shemot tabernacle instruction text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for curtains, coverings, frames, bars, veil, screen, and spatial arrangement of holy/most holy.

verses.restored: And dwelling-place you shall make: ten curtains of fine twisted linen, blue, purple, and scarlet, with cherubim, work of skilled designer, you shall make them.

familiar.text: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them.

modern.text: “You are to construct the tabernacle itself with ten curtains of finely spun linen, each with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and cherubim skillfully worked into them.

original.text: וְאֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֥ן תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה עֶ֣שֶׂר יְרִיעֹ֑ת שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֗ר וּתְכֵ֤לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן֙ וְתֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֔י כְּרֻבִ֛ים מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֖ב תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם

verses.restored: Length of one curtain twenty-eight cubits, width four cubits; one measure for all curtains.

familiar.text: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and every one of the curtains shall have one measure.

modern.text: Each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide —all curtains the same size.

original.text: אֹ֣רֶךְ הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הָֽאַחַ֗ת שְׁמֹנֶ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֨חַב֙ אַרְבַּ֣ע בָּאַמָּ֔ה הַיְרִיעָ֖ה הָאֶחָ֑ת מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֖ת לְכָל הַיְרִיעֹֽת

verses.restored: Five curtains shall be joined one to another, and five curtains joined one to another.

familiar.text: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another.

modern.text: Five of the curtains are to be joined together, and the other five joined as well.

original.text: חֲמֵ֣שׁ הַיְרִיעֹ֗ת תִּֽהְיֶ֨יןָ֙ חֹֽבְרֹ֔ת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל אֲחֹתָ֑הּ וְחָמֵ֤שׁ יְרִיעֹת֙ חֹֽבְרֹ֔ת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל אֲחֹתָֽהּ

verses.restored: You shall make loops of blue on edge of one curtain at end of set, and likewise on edge of outer curtain in second set.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.

modern.text: Make loops of blue material on the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and do the same for the end curtain in the second set.

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ לֻֽלְאֹ֣ת תְּכֵ֗לֶת עַ֣ל שְׂפַ֤ת הַיְרִיעָה֙ הָאֶחָ֔ת מִקָּצָ֖ה בַּחֹבָ֑רֶת וְכֵ֤ן תַּעֲשֶׂה֙ בִּשְׂפַ֣ת הַיְרִיעָ֔ה הַקִּ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה בַּמַּחְבֶּ֖רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית

verses.restored: Fifty loops you shall make in one curtain, and fifty loops at edge of curtain in second set, loops opposite each other.

familiar.text: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second; that the loops may take hold one of another.

modern.text: Make fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the second set, so that the loops line up opposite one another.

original.text: חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻֽלָאֹ֗ת תַּעֲשֶׂה֮ בַּיְרִיעָ֣ה הָאֶחָת֒ וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻֽלָאֹ֗ת תַּעֲשֶׂה֙ בִּקְצֵ֣ה הַיְרִיעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בַּמַּחְבֶּ֣רֶת הַשֵּׁנִ֑ית מַקְבִּילֹת֙ הַלֻּ֣לָאֹ֔ת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל אֲחֹתָֽהּ

verses.restored: Make fifty gold clasps and join curtains one to another with clasps, so dwelling-place shall be one.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make fifty taches of gold, and couple the curtains together with the taches: and it shall be one tabernacle.

modern.text: Make fifty gold clasps as well, and join the curtains together with the clasps, so that the tabernacle will be a unit. The Eleven Curtains of Goat Hair (Exodus 36:14–19)

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֕יתָ חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים קַרְסֵ֣י זָהָ֑ב וְחִבַּרְתָּ֨ אֶת הַיְרִיעֹ֜ת אִשָּׁ֤ה אֶל אֲחֹתָהּ֙ בַּקְּרָסִ֔ים וְהָיָ֥ה הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן אֶחָֽד

verses.restored: You shall make curtains of goats' hair for tent over dwelling-place; eleven curtains you shall make.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make curtains of goats’ hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou make.

modern.text: You are to make curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven curtains in all.

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֨יתָ֙ יְרִיעֹ֣ת עִזִּ֔ים לְאֹ֖הֶל עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עַשְׁתֵּי עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה יְרִיעֹ֖ת תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם

verses.restored: Length of one curtain thirty cubits, width four cubits; one measure for eleven curtains.

familiar.text: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure.

modern.text: Each of the eleven curtains is to be the same size—thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.

original.text: אֹ֣רֶךְ הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הָֽאַחַ֗ת שְׁלֹשִׁים֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֨חַב֙ אַרְבַּ֣ע בָּאַמָּ֔ה הַיְרִיעָ֖ה הָאֶחָ֑ת מִדָּ֣ה אַחַ֔ת לְעַשְׁתֵּ֥י עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה יְרִיעֹֽת

verses.restored: Join five curtains by themselves and six curtains by themselves, and fold sixth curtain at front of tent.

familiar.text: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.

modern.text: Join five of the curtains into one set and the other six into another. Then fold the sixth curtain over double at the front of the tent.

original.text: וְחִבַּרְתָּ֞ אֶת חֲמֵ֤שׁ הַיְרִיעֹת֙ לְבָ֔ד וְאֶת שֵׁ֥שׁ הַיְרִיעֹ֖ת לְבָ֑ד וְכָפַלְתָּ֙ אֶת הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הַשִּׁשִּׁ֔ית אֶל מ֖וּל פְּנֵ֥י הָאֹֽהֶל

verses.restored: Make fifty loops on edge of one outer curtain of set, and fifty loops on edge of curtain of second set.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.

modern.text: Make fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and fifty loops along the edge of the corresponding curtain in the second set.

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻֽלָאֹ֗ת עַ֣ל שְׂפַ֤ת הַיְרִיעָה֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ת הַקִּיצֹנָ֖ה בַּחֹבָ֑רֶת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻֽלָאֹ֗ת עַ֚ל שְׂפַ֣ת הַיְרִיעָ֔ה הַחֹבֶ֖רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית

verses.restored: Make fifty bronze clasps, bring clasps into loops, and join tent so it shall be one.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make fifty taches of brass, and put the taches into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.

modern.text: Make fifty bronze clasps and put them through the loops to join the tent together as a unit.

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֛יתָ קַרְסֵ֥י נְחֹ֖שֶׁת חֲמִשִּׁ֑ים וְהֵבֵאתָ֤ אֶת הַקְּרָסִים֙ בַּלֻּ֣לָאֹ֔ת וְחִבַּרְתָּ֥ אֶת הָאֹ֖הֶל וְהָיָ֥ה אֶחָֽד

verses.restored: Surplus hanging over curtains of tent, half curtain surplus, shall hang over back of dwelling-place.

familiar.text: And the remnant that remaineth of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remaineth, shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle.

modern.text: As for the overlap that remains of the tent curtains, the half curtain that is left over shall hang down over the back of the tabernacle.

original.text: וְסֶ֨רַח֙ הָעֹדֵ֔ף בִּירִיעֹ֖ת הָאֹ֑הֶל חֲצִ֤י הַיְרִיעָה֙ הָעֹדֶ֔פֶת תִּסְרַ֕ח עַ֖ל אֲחֹרֵ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן

verses.restored: Cubit on one side and cubit on other side of surplus length of curtains of tent shall hang over sides of dwelling-place, to cover it.

familiar.text: And a cubit on the one side, and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent, it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.

modern.text: And the tent curtains will be a cubit longer on either side, and the excess will hang over the sides of the tabernacle to cover it.

original.text: וְהָאַמָּ֨ה מִזֶּ֜ה וְהָאַמָּ֤ה מִזֶּה֙ בָּעֹדֵ֔ף בְּאֹ֖רֶךְ יְרִיעֹ֣ת הָאֹ֑הֶל יִהְיֶ֨ה סָר֜וּחַ עַל צִדֵּ֧י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן מִזֶּ֥ה וּמִזֶּ֖ה לְכַסֹּתֽוֹ

verses.restored: Make covering for tent of reddened ram skins, and covering of durable hides above.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering above of badgers’ skins.

modern.text: Also make a covering for the tent out of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of fine leather. The Frames and Bases (Exodus 36:20–34)

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ מִכְסֶה֙ לָאֹ֔הֶל עֹרֹ֥ת אֵילִ֖ם מְאָדָּמִ֑ים וּמִכְסֵ֛ה עֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים מִלְמָֽעְלָה

verses.restored: You shall make frames for dwelling-place of acacia wood, standing upright.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up.

modern.text: You are to construct upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת הַקְּרָשִׁ֖ים לַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּ֖ים עֹמְדִֽים

verses.restored: Ten cubits length of frame, and one and a half cubits width of one frame.

familiar.text: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board.

modern.text: Each frame is to be ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.

original.text: עֶ֥שֶׂר אַמּ֖וֹת אֹ֣רֶךְ הַקָּ֑רֶשׁ וְאַמָּה֙ וַחֲצִ֣י הָֽאַמָּ֔ה רֹ֖חַב הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד

verses.restored: Two tenons for one frame, joined each to other; so you shall do for all frames of dwelling-place.

familiar.text: Two tenons shall there be in one board, set in order one against another: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

modern.text: Two tenons must be connected to each other for each frame. Make all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.

original.text: שְׁתֵּ֣י יָד֗וֹת לַקֶּ֨רֶשׁ֙ הָאֶחָ֔ד מְשֻׁלָּבֹ֔ת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל אֲחֹתָ֑הּ כֵּ֣ן תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל קַרְשֵׁ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן

verses.restored: Make frames for dwelling-place: twenty frames for south side, toward south.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.

modern.text: Construct twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle,

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת הַקְּרָשִׁ֖ים לַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עֶשְׂרִ֣ים קֶ֔רֶשׁ לִפְאַ֖ת נֶ֥גְבָּה תֵימָֽנָה

verses.restored: Forty silver bases you shall make under twenty frames, two bases under one frame for its two tenons and two bases under another frame for its two tenons.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.

modern.text: with forty silver bases under the twenty frames—two bases for each frame, one under each tenon.

original.text: וְאַרְבָּעִים֙ אַדְנֵי כֶ֔סֶף תַּעֲשֶׂ֕ה תַּ֖חַת עֶשְׂרִ֣ים הַקָּ֑רֶשׁ שְׁנֵ֨י אֲדָנִ֜ים תַּֽחַת הַקֶּ֤רֶשׁ הָאֶחָד֙ לִשְׁתֵּ֣י יְדֹתָ֔יו וּשְׁנֵ֧י אֲדָנִ֛ים תַּֽחַת הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָ֖ד לִשְׁתֵּ֥י יְדֹתָֽיו

verses.restored: For second side of dwelling-place, north side, twenty frames,

familiar.text: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards:

modern.text: For the second side of the tabernacle, the north side, make twenty frames

original.text: וּלְצֶ֧לַע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית לִפְאַ֣ת צָפ֑וֹן עֶשְׂרִ֖ים קָֽרֶשׁ

verses.restored: and their forty silver bases, two bases under one frame and two bases under another frame.

familiar.text: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

modern.text: and forty silver bases—two bases under each frame.

original.text: וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים אַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם כָּ֑סֶף שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֗ים תַּ֚חַת הַקֶּ֣רֶשׁ הָֽאֶחָ֔ד וּשְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד

verses.restored: For rear of dwelling-place westward, make six frames.

familiar.text: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.

modern.text: Make six frames for the rear of the tabernacle, the west side,

original.text: וּֽלְיַרְכְּתֵ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן יָ֑מָּה תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה שִׁשָּׁ֥ה קְרָשִֽׁים

verses.restored: Make two frames for corners of dwelling-place in rear.

familiar.text: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.

modern.text: and two frames for the two back corners of the tabernacle,

original.text: וּשְׁנֵ֤י קְרָשִׁים֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה לִמְקֻצְעֹ֖ת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן בַּיַּרְכָתָֽיִם

verses.restored: They shall be doubled below and together complete at top into one ring; so it shall be for them both, for two corners.

familiar.text: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it unto one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.

modern.text: coupled together from bottom to top and fitted into a single ring. These will serve as the two corners.

original.text: וְיִֽהְי֣וּ תֹֽאֲמִים֮ מִלְּמַטָּה֒ וְיַחְדָּ֗ו יִהְי֤וּ תַמִּים֙ עַל רֹאשׁ֔וֹ אֶל הַטַּבַּ֖עַת הָאֶחָ֑ת כֵּ֚ן יִהְיֶ֣ה לִשְׁנֵיהֶ֔ם לִשְׁנֵ֥י הַמִּקְצֹעֹ֖ת יִהְיֽוּ

verses.restored: There shall be eight frames and their silver bases, sixteen bases, two bases under one frame and two bases under another frame.

familiar.text: And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

modern.text: So there are to be eight frames and sixteen silver bases—two under each frame.

original.text: וְהָיוּ֙ שְׁמֹנָ֣ה קְרָשִׁ֔ים וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֣ם כֶּ֔סֶף שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אֲדָנִ֑ים שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֗ים תַּ֚חַת הַקֶּ֣רֶשׁ הָאֶחָ֔ד וּשְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד

verses.restored: Make bars of acacia wood: five for frames of one side of dwelling-place,

familiar.text: And thou shalt make bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

modern.text: You are also to make five crossbars of acacia wood for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ בְרִיחִ֖ם עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים חֲמִשָּׁ֕ה לְקַרְשֵׁ֥י צֶֽלַע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן הָאֶחָֽד

verses.restored: five bars for frames of second side of dwelling-place, and five bars for frames of side of dwelling-place at rear westward.

familiar.text: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the two sides westward.

modern.text: five for those on the other side, and five for those on the rear side of the tabernacle, to the west.

original.text: וַחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה בְרִיחִ֔ם לְקַרְשֵׁ֥י צֶֽלַע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן הַשֵּׁנִ֑ית וַחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה בְרִיחִ֗ם לְקַרְשֵׁי֙ צֶ֣לַע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן לַיַּרְכָתַ֖יִם יָֽמָּה

verses.restored: Middle bar in midst of frames shall pass through from end to end.

familiar.text: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.

modern.text: The central crossbar in the middle of the frames shall extend from one end to the other.

original.text: וְהַבְּרִ֥יחַ הַתִּיכֹ֖ן בְּת֣וֹךְ הַקְּרָשִׁ֑ים מַבְרִ֕חַ מִן הַקָּצֶ֖ה אֶל הַקָּצֶֽה

verses.restored: Overlay frames with gold, make their rings of gold as housings for bars, and overlay bars with gold.

familiar.text: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars: and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.

modern.text: Overlay the frames with gold and make gold rings to hold the crossbars. Also overlay the crossbars with gold.

original.text: וְֽאֶת הַקְּרָשִׁ֞ים תְּצַפֶּ֣ה זָהָ֗ב וְאֶת טַבְּעֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה זָהָ֔ב בָּתִּ֖ים לַבְּרִיחִ֑ם וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֶת הַבְּרִיחִ֖ם זָהָֽב

verses.restored: Set up dwelling-place according to its judgment/pattern that you were shown on mountain.

familiar.text: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which was shewed thee in the mount.

modern.text: So you are to set up the tabernacle according to the pattern shown you on the mountain. The Veil (Exodus 36:35–36)

original.text: וַהֲקֵמֹתָ֖ אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן כְּמִ֨שְׁפָּט֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָרְאֵ֖יתָ בָּהָֽר

verses.restored: Make veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twisted linen; work of skilled designer; it shall be made with cherubim.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen of cunning work: with cherubims shall it be made:

modern.text: Make a veil of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen, with cherubim skillfully worked into it.

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ פָרֹ֗כֶת תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֛ב יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָ֖הּ כְּרֻבִֽים

verses.restored: Put it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold, their hooks gold, on four silver bases.

familiar.text: And thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold: their hooks shall be of gold, upon the four sockets of silver.

modern.text: Hang it with gold hooks on four posts of acacia wood, overlaid with gold and standing on four silver bases.

original.text: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה אֹתָ֗הּ עַל אַרְבָּעָה֙ עַמּוּדֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים מְצֻפִּ֣ים זָהָ֔ב וָוֵיהֶ֖ם זָהָ֑ב עַל אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אַדְנֵי כָֽסֶף

verses.restored: Put veil under clasps, and bring ark of testimony there inside veil; veil shall separate for you between Holy Place and Holy of Holies.

familiar.text: And thou shalt hang up the vail under the taches, that thou mayest bring in thither within the vail the ark of the testimony: and the vail shall divide unto you between the holy place and the most holy.

modern.text: And hang the veil from the clasps and place the ark of the Testimony behind the veil. So the veil will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.

original.text: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה אֶת הַפָּרֹכֶת֮ תַּ֣חַת הַקְּרָסִים֒ וְהֵבֵאתָ֥ שָׁ֨מָּה֙ מִבֵּ֣ית לַפָּרֹ֔כֶת אֵ֖ת אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵד֑וּת וְהִבְדִּילָ֤ה הַפָּרֹ֨כֶת֙ לָכֶ֔ם בֵּ֣ין הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וּבֵ֖ין קֹ֥דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים

verses.restored: Put cover upon ark of testimony in Holy of Holies.

familiar.text: And thou shalt put the mercy seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place.

modern.text: Put the mercy seat on the ark of the Testimony in the Most Holy Place.

original.text: וְנָתַתָּ֙ אֶת הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת עַ֖ל אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵדֻ֑ת בְּקֹ֖דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים

verses.restored: Set table outside veil, and lampstand opposite table on south side of dwelling-place; table put on north side.

familiar.text: And thou shalt set the table without the vail, and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and thou shalt put the table on the north side.

modern.text: And place the table outside the veil on the north side of the tabernacle, and put the lampstand opposite the table, on the south side. The Curtain for the Entrance (Exodus 36:37–38)

original.text: וְשַׂמְתָּ֤ אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ מִח֣וּץ לַפָּרֹ֔כֶת וְאֶת הַמְּנֹרָה֙ נֹ֣כַח הַשֻּׁלְחָ֔ן עַ֛ל צֶ֥לַע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן תֵּימָ֑נָה וְהַ֨שֻּׁלְחָ֔ן תִּתֵּ֖ן עַל צֶ֥לַע צָפֽוֹן

verses.restored: Make screen for entrance of tent, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twisted linen, work of embroiderer.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make an hanging for the door of the tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework.

modern.text: For the entrance to the tent, you are to make a curtain embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen.

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ מָסָךְ֙ לְפֶ֣תַח הָאֹ֔הֶל תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֹקֵֽם

verses.restored: Make for screen five pillars of acacia, overlay them with gold, their hooks gold, and cast for them five bronze bases.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, and their hooks shall be of gold: and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.

modern.text: Make five posts of acacia wood for the curtain, overlay them with gold hooks, and cast five bronze bases for them.

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ לַמָּסָ֗ךְ חֲמִשָּׁה֙ עַמּוּדֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וְצִפִּיתָ֤ אֹתָם֙ זָהָ֔ב וָוֵיהֶ֖ם זָהָ֑ב וְיָצַקְתָּ֣ לָהֶ֔ם חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה אַדְנֵ֥י נְחֹֽשֶׁת

translation_notes: Dwelling-place/mishkan is a layered portable sacred space, not monumental empire architecture.
Repeated 'so it shall be one' emphasizes joined unity through many pieces.
Cherubim on curtains and veil mark guarded holy presence, echoing Eden/ark imagery.
Veil separates Holy Place and Holy of Holies; spatial holiness should be preserved without overreading later theology too early.
safety_note: This chapter is technical sacred craft. Avoid flattening it into mere decoration; it is ordered, portable holiness for a liberated wilderness people.
